notes: Crew booking now carries everything about each person, so you can work entirely from there: email, call time, rate, days, freelance agreement status and a Take off the job button. Setting someone to Needs to sign is what puts the signing link in their booking email - that was only settable on the crew card before, which is why the link never appeared. The list also stopped rebuilding itself on every keystroke; it was replacing the row between you pressing and releasing the mouse, so a click could land on nothing. The camera count that triggers the longer load-in is now yours to set, next to the solo operator hours in App settings.
